fields.why: The Table gives prevalence for 4 age groups and 4 race/ethnicity groups, and the text assesses differences across both.
Age and race/ethnicity are the SPDs with 3 or more groups; HIV status, STD testing and city are not SPDs, and MSM only defines the population.

Race claims are Black and Hispanic vs a named White referent under unnamed bivariate tests: per-group vs referent only. For age, '18–29 compared with older men' may pool the older groups (then the 4-group Table values are only side by side), but per-group vs the 18–29 referent is the more natural reading, as A notes in view_issues.
